title: Annotatio IV §.V cont.: Koinonia = spiritual communion with Christ and one another + bread-breaking
pass_a_gloss: That is, to spiritual Communion both with Christ and His body and blood and among themselves, and joined to this the breaking of bread (tē klasei tou artou), prefiguring and always to prefigure the body broken for you (1 Cor. 11:24).
pass_b_english: That koinōnia is spiritual communion with Christ and His body and blood, and among themselves.
Joined to it is the breaking of bread — always prefiguring the body broken for you (1 Cor. 11:24).
source_text: I. e. tàm cum Christo ejusque corpore & sanguine, quàm inter se, Communioni spirituali, huicq; junctæ tē klasei tou artou, i. e. fractioni panis, to sōma hyper hymōn klōmenon præfiguranti, & semper præfiguraturæ, 1. Cor. 11. 24.
